description: Verify that the DUT-side DHCPv4 client listens on UDP port 68 and runs the full DISCOVER → OFFER → REQUEST lifecycle (RFC 2131 §4.1 MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
The positive baseline: with a normal server emul, DUT must complete the DORA exchange — emit DISCOVER, accept OFFER (delivered to UDP:68), emit REQUEST. Anchors all the negative-shape cases.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → wire: DHCPDISCOVER.
2. Tester → DUT: DHCPOFFER (delivered to UDP:68).
3. DUT → wire: DHCPREQUEST.

[Pass condition]
DISCOVER + REQUEST observed in the listen window.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_discover — DUT did not emit DHCPDISCOVER
• Fail_no_request — DUT did not emit DHCPREQUEST after the OFFER

verdicts.Pass: DUT completed DISCOVER → OFFER → REQUEST — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
